# Team meeting guidance

Keep this folder sparse. The generic meeting lenses already cover common rituals; add a file only when this team runs a meeting differently or has a recurring meeting the generic set does not describe.

Use plain Markdown. Do not add identifiers, inheritance declarations, or configuration syntax. `/process-transcript` matches the prose and combines every relevant file with the generic lenses.

## A familiar ritual that differs here

Name the file after the familiar meeting, for example `refinement.md`:

```markdown
# Refinement — team-specific guidance

## What is different here

[Describe the meaningful difference from an ordinary refinement.]

## Pay extra attention to

[Describe signals or outcomes that matter especially to this team.]

## Do not infer

[Describe familiar language or behaviour that means something different here.]
```

## A team-specific recurring meeting

Use the team's ordinary name for the file, for example `customer-escalation-huddle.md`:

```markdown
# Customer escalation huddle

## How to recognise it

[Describe when this meeting happens, who is usually involved, and how it sounds.]

## What matters in this meeting

[Describe the signals, distinctions, and unresolved questions worth capturing.]

## What useful output looks like

[Describe what the team expects to leave with.]
```

Write or edit these files directly when the team already knows what it wants captured, or let the `/setup-awow` workshop or guided setup draft them. Use `/update-context` to amend an existing file when the team later states a durable correction.
